note: One entry per FR3 (roadmap B2). Every entry point that drives an arm names the arm (or its IP) explicitly; nothing falls back to a default arm. robot_ip and corenetic_device_id must equal the arm's replay_config (checked by fr3_arms.validate). payload is the end-effector load Desk should hold for the arm as it is mounted now; null = not declared, and preflight then only reports what Desk holds. start_joints_rad is where move_to_start takes the arm.

right.start_source: panda_py constants.JOINT_POSITION_START (what Panda.move_to_start() used before B2)
right.payload_note: Gripper away for repair since 10-23. 10-12 Desk held m_ee 1.111 kg, F_x_Cee (16.8, -22.2, 60.9) mm with gripper + SMR (outputs/fr3_payload/20261012_154421_fr3_smr_in.json on Thor); declare the value F2 identifies once the gripper is back.

left.why_not: B1: the second FR3 is not installed yet (Q1: IP, FCI activation, network Q5 still open). It will stand to the left of the right arm.
